gns_energy_identity.implementation: For either sigma, theta invariance gives the canonical covariant GNS implementation U_sigma(t)pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma=pi_sigma(theta_t A)Omega_sigma. Groundness fixes U_sigma(t)=exp(i t H_sigma/hbar) with H_sigma>=0 and H_sigma Omega_sigma=0.
gns_energy_identity.vector_identity: For A in D_bl subset Dom(delta_H), differentiating the covariant identity in GNS norm gives H_sigma pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma=-i hbar pi_sigma(delta_H A)Omega_sigma.
gns_energy_identity.energy_identity: Therefore -i hbar omega_sigma(A^*delta_H A)=<pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma,H_sigma pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma>=||H_sigma^(1/2)pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma||^2. Since H_sigma Omega_sigma=0, centering A does not change this energy.
gns_energy_identity.scope: The identity uses only invariance, ground positivity and A in Dom(delta_H). It assumes neither faithfulness, purity, factoriality nor a simple zero-energy kernel.

centered_bandlimited_form_core.centered_space: C_sigma={pi_sigma(A)Omega_sigma-omega_sigma(A)Omega_sigma:A in D_bl} is a linear subspace of Dom(H_sigma^(1/2)) intersect Omega_sigma^perp.
centered_bandlimited_form_core.spectral_cutoff: For xi in Dom(H_sigma^(1/2)) intersect Omega_sigma^perp choose chi_R in C_c^infinity(R) with chi_R(E)->1 on E>=0 and chi_R(H_sigma)xi->xi in the form norm ||zeta||^2+||H_sigma^(1/2)zeta||^2.
centered_bandlimited_form_core.orbit_smear_realisation: Choose a Schwartz g_R with compact Fourier support and hat g_R(E/hbar)=chi_R(E) on the positive implementing spectrum. Then pi_sigma(theta_(g_R)(B))Omega_sigma=chi_R(H_sigma)pi_sigma(B)Omega_sigma, and theta_(g_R)(B) belongs to D_bl.
centered_bandlimited_form_core.two_stage_approximation: First approximate xi by cyclic vectors pi_sigma(B_n)Omega_sigma. At fixed R, the compact energy support makes H_sigma^(1/2) bounded on the filtered range, so Hilbert convergence of the filtered vectors upgrades to form convergence. Subtract their Omega_sigma projections and then diagonalize in R,n.
centered_bandlimited_form_core.conclusion: C_sigma is a form core for H_sigma^(1/2) on Omega_sigma^perp even if ker(H_sigma) is not known to be one-dimensional.

rayleigh_and_parity_reduction.rayleigh_equality: Delta_sigma^P=inf_(A in D_bl, Var>0){-i hbar omega_sigma(A^*delta_H A)/Var_(omega_sigma)(A)} equals inf sigma(H_sigma restricted to Omega_sigma^perp), because the centered D_bl vectors are a form core.
rayleigh_and_parity_reduction.simple_kernel: If Delta_sigma^P>0, then every zero-energy vector orthogonal to Omega_sigma vanishes. Thus ker(H_sigma)=C Omega_sigma and H_sigma restricted to Omega_sigma^perp is at least Delta_sigma^P.
rayleigh_and_parity_reduction.parity_unitary: The isometry W_gamma pi_-(A)Omega_-=pi_+(gamma(A))Omega_+ extends to a unitary, and gamma theta_t=theta_t gamma gives W_gamma H_- W_gamma^*=H_+. Consequently Delta_-^P=Delta_+^P.
rayleigh_and_parity_reduction.parity_scope: This is parity-twisted unitary equivalence. It proves no untwisted quasi-equivalence, purity, factoriality or disjointness statement.

finite_source_gap_collapse.overlap: Choose the positive phases and put c_L=<phi_L^+,phi_L^->. The fixed contraction b has an expectation split at least d, while the norm distance of two vector states is 2 sqrt(1-c_L^2). Hence 1-c_L^2>=d^2/4 eventually.
finite_source_gap_collapse.orthogonal_trial: For H_L(+h_L), zeta_L=(phi_L^--c_L phi_L^+)/sqrt(1-c_L^2) is orthogonal to its unique ground. The common form domain and H_L(+h_L)=H_L(-h_L)-2h_L S_L give q_(H_L(+h_L)-E_L(h_L))[zeta_L]=2 h_L s_L^+/(1-c_L^2). Parity gives the same statement for the other sign.
finite_source_gap_collapse.exact_upper_bound: The full finite-volume source gap obeys Delta_(L,sigma)^full<=8 C_S h_L V/d^2=[32 sqrt(B_a)/(r_w^2 rho_*)] h_L V->0.
finite_source_gap_collapse.canonical_rate: For h_L=h_* V^(-3/2), Delta_(L,sigma)^full<=[32 sqrt(B_a)h_*/(r_w^2 rho_*)]V^(-1/2).
finite_source_gap_collapse.route_boundary: The L-dependent zeta_L is a global parity-branch-switching trial. Its collapse blocks using the full finite-source gap as a positive uniform Poincare input, but does not refute a positive phasewise target gap on the fixed D_bl core.

fixed_carrier_limit_coercivity.finite_form: For fixed A in D_bl put cal E_L^sigma(A)=q_(H_L(sigma h_L)-E_L(h_L))[pi_L^0(A)phi_L^sigma].
fixed_carrier_limit_coercivity.limit_identity: Along the selected joint cluster, v4.0 residual closure and weak-star convergence give cal E_L^sigma(A)->-i hbar omega_sigma(A^*delta_H A), while Var_(omega_L^sigma)(A)->Var_(omega_sigma)(A).
fixed_carrier_limit_coercivity.exact_equivalence: For any Delta>0, H_sigma restricted to Omega_sigma^perp is at least Delta if and only if lim_L[cal E_L^sigma(A)-Delta Var_(omega_L^sigma)(A)]>=0 for every fixed A in D_bl. By parity it suffices to prove one sign.
fixed_carrier_limit_coercivity.order_of_operations: The common Delta must hold after fixing the carrier element and passing its form and variance to the selected cluster. The vanishing full finite gap is an infimum over L-dependent global directions; inf_A lim_L and lim_L inf_A cannot be interchanged.
fixed_carrier_limit_coercivity.remaining_open_input: No uniform positive D_bl coercive lower bound is proved. That phasewise bound, or an independently identified Yarotskii/QPS branch with cutoff-stable intertwining to this carrier, remains the load-bearing GNS-gap input.
